item.title: Deploy Layer5 Cloud
item.description:
This guide installs the layer5-cloud chart, which deploys the Layer5 Cloud server together with Kratos and Hydra. It assumes you have made the decisions in Plan a Deployment. The commands use the release name layer5-cloud in the namespace layer5-cloud.

Prerequisites 🔗

  • A Kubernetes cluster and Helm 3.
  • An ingress controller that supports WebSocket upgrades, and a TLS certificate for your hostname.
  • A PostgreSQL server you can create databases on.
  • An SMTP relay that satisfies the mail constraints, or the decision to run without mail.
  • The OAuth applications for Google and GitHub, if you offer social sign-in.

Install 🔗

1. Prepare the database 🔗

Create one role and three databases on your PostgreSQL server, then create the uuid-ossp extension in the meshery database. The server creates the schema itself.
